nodes.name: Retell Webhook
nodes.notes: Retell fires call_started, call_ended, and call_analyzed to this same URL. Everything downstream filters to call_ended only.

nodes.name: Verify Signature
nodes.notes: Needs NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto set on the n8n container (see docker-compose.yml) or require('crypto') fails.

nodes.name: Respond 401 Invalid Signature
nodes.notes: If this fires repeatedly, check RETELL_API_KEY hasn't rotated on Retell's side.

parameters.jsCode: throw new Error(`No contractor found for Twilio number ${$('Verify Signature').item.json.to_number}. A call came in on a number that doesn't match any contractor — check for a provisioning mismatch.`);

nodes.name: No Contractor Match - Alert
nodes.notes: Deliberately throws so the workflow's attached Error Workflow (see error-workflow.json) fires and alerts you directly.

nodes.name: Find or Create Customer
nodes.notes: ignore-duplicates means a repeat caller's existing row comes back as-is (empty body) rather than erroring; the next node re-fetches by phone either way.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ {"contractor_id": $('IF Contractor Found').item.json[0].id, "customer_id": $json[0].id, "retell_call_id": $('Verify Signature').item.json.call_id, "caller_phone": $('Verify Signature').item.json.from_number, "twilio_number": $('Verify Signature').item.json.to_number, "duration_seconds": Math.round(($('Verify Signature').item.json.duration_ms || 0) / 1000), "transcript_text": $('Verify Signature').item.json.transcript || '', "recording_url": $('Verify Signature').item.json.recording_url, "status": "processing", "raw_metadata": $('Verify Signature').item.json} }}

nodes.name: Insert Transcript
nodes.notes: retell_call_id is UNIQUE (from Phase 1) — a retried webhook delivery for a call already inserted comes back empty here, which the next node treats as 'already processed, stop'.

nodes.name: Respond 200 Accepted
nodes.notes: Retell only needs this fast 2xx. Claude + brief creation + SMS below can safely take longer than Retell's 10s retry window since this already unblocked it.

nodes.name: IF Passes Quality Check
nodes.notes: Acceptance test: calls under 15s produce no brief.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { transcript_id: $('Insert Transcript').item.json[0].id, new_status: 'no_brief', reason: 'under 15s or empty transcript' } }];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ {"model": "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001", "max_tokens": 1536, "system": [{"type": "text", "text": "You are analyzing a phone call transcript between an AI receptionist (Sarah) and a homeowner who called a roofing contractor. Extract structured data and assess whether this is a qualified lead worth the contractor's immediate attention. Respond with ONLY valid JSON matching this exact schema, no other text:\\n{\\n  \"qualification\": \"qualified\" | \"not_qualified\",\\n  \"homeowner_name\": string | null,\\n  \"homeowner_email\": string | null,\\n  \"property_address\": string | null,\\n  \"damage_type\": \"roof\" | \"siding\" | \"gutters\" | \"other\" | null,\\n  \"damage_description\": string | null,\\n  \"damage_severity\": \"minor\" | \"moderate\" | \"severe\" | null,\\n  \"interior_damage\": boolean,\\n  \"insurance_carrier\": string | null,\\n  \"has_filed_claim\": boolean,\\n  \"claim_number\": string | null,\\n  \"competitor_mentioned\": boolean,\\n  \"competitor_name\": string | null,\\n  \"competitor_scheduled\": boolean,\\n  \"competitor_timing\": string | null,\\n  \"urgency\": \"low\" | \"medium\" | \"high\" | \"critical\",\\n  \"estimated_value_low\": number | null,\\n  \"estimated_value_high\": number | null,\\n  \"lead_score\": integer 0-100,\\n  \"appointment_probability\": integer 0-100,\\n  \"recommended_action\": string,\\n  \"recommended_follow_up\": string | null,\\n  \"situation_summary\": string,\\n  \"suggested_opening\": string (a natural opening line for the contractor to use when calling back \u2014 reference something specific from the call),\\n  \"risk_flags\": string[] (short phrases, e.g. \"water intrusion active\", \"elderly homeowner alone\"),\\n  \"key_objections\": string[] (concerns the homeowner raised, if any),\\n  \"confidence_score\": integer 0-100 (how confident you are in this assessment),\\n  \"data_completeness\": integer 0-100 (how much of this schema the call actually supported vs. inferred)\\n}\\nIf the call doesn't support a field, use null (or false/0 for booleans/numbers, [] for arrays) rather than guessing.", "cache_control": {"type": "ephemeral"}}], "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": $('Verify Signature').item.json.transcript}]} }}

nodes.name: Call Claude - Win Brief AI
nodes.notes: 3 retries handles 429/529/5xx. Non-retryable 4xx (bad key etc.) still exhausts retries uselessly here — n8n doesn't let you branch retry-vs-not per status code natively, so the Error Workflow catches the final failure either way.

nodes.name: Record Call Start Time
nodes.notes: Captures a timestamp so the next-but-one node can compute real ai_latency_ms, rather than the Claude call's own duration (which the API response doesn't report directly).

nodes.name: Parse and Validate AI Output
nodes.notes: Validates schema before anything touches the DB — a malformed response is treated the same as an API failure (status='failed'), not force-fit into NOT NULL columns.

nodes.name: IF Valid and Qualified
nodes.notes: Acceptance test: non-qualified calls produce no brief. Malformed/failed AI output also lands here (valid=false), routed to 'failed' instead of 'no_brief' below.

nodes.name: Update Transcript Status (no brief/failed)
nodes.notes: Cost is recorded even when the call didn't qualify — every Claude call costs money whether or not it produces a brief, so this is where 'no_brief' rows still get their ai_cost_usd filled in.

nodes.name: Compute Customer Enrichment
nodes.notes: Fills gaps only — a repeat caller's already-good name/email/address is never clobbered by a later call's AI extraction.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ {"contractor_id": $('IF Contractor Found').item.json[0].id, "transcript_id": $('Insert Transcript').item.json[0].id, "customer_id": $('Compute Customer Enrichment').item.json.customer_id, "damage_type": $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.damage_type, "damage_description": $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.damage_description, "damage_severity": $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.damage_severity, "interior_damage": $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.interior_damage ?? false, "insurance_carrier": $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.insurance_carrier, "has_filed_claim": $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.has_filed_claim ?? false, "claim_number": $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.claim_number, "competitor_mentioned": $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.competitor_mentioned ?? false, "competitor_name": $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.competitor_name, "competitor_scheduled": $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.competitor_scheduled ?? false, "competitor_timing": $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.competitor_timing, "urgency": $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.urgency, "estimated_value_low": $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.estimated_value_low, "estimated_value_high": $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.estimated_value_high, "lead_score": $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.lead_score, "appointment_probability": $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.appointment_probability, "recommended_action": $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.recommended_action, "recommended_follow_up": $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.recommended_follow_up, "situation_summary": $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.situation_summary, "suggested_opening": $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.suggested_opening, "risk_flags": $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.risk_flags ?? [], "key_objections": $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.key_objections ?? [], "confidence_score": $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.confidence_score, "data_completeness": $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.data_completeness, "ai_model": $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.ai_model, "ai_raw_output": $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json} }}

nodes.name: Insert Brief
nodes.notes: Full Claude JSON goes into ai_raw_output for fidelity — fields like the summary that don't have a dedicated column aren't lost, just not individually queryable yet.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ {"status": "completed", "ai_model": $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.ai_model, "ai_input_tokens": $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.ai_input_tokens, "ai_output_tokens": $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.ai_output_tokens, "ai_cache_read_tokens": $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.ai_cache_read_tokens, "ai_cost_usd": $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.ai_cost_usd, "ai_latency_ms": $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.ai_latency_ms} }}

={{ {"contractor_id": $('IF Contractor Found').item.json[0].id, "type": "new_lead", "title": "New lead: " + ($('Compute Customer Enrichment').item.json.patch.name || 'a homeowner'), "body": $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.situation_summary, "link_type": "brief", "link_id": $('Insert Brief').item.json[0].id, "channels_sent": ["in_app"]} }}

nodes.name: Insert Notification
nodes.notes: channels_sent starts as just in_app; the SMS branch below PATCHes this to add 'sms' only if Twilio confirms the send.

parameters.name: Body
parameters.value: =New high-value lead: {{$('Compute Customer Enrichment').item.json.patch.name || 'a homeowner'}} — ${{$('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.estimated_value_low}}-${{$('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.estimated_value_high}}. Check your dashboard.

nodes.name: Send SMS via Twilio
nodes.notes: continueOnFail=true is deliberate: the brief and notification are already committed by this point, so a Twilio failure (bad number, account issue) shouldn't roll anything back or error the whole run — it just means the contractor only gets the in-app notification, reflected below.
